motion.evidence: Framer-driven. 48 scroll effects (1 pin, 8 rotate, 14 transform/parallax, 12 scale, 13 background-shift); 254 IntersectionObservers / 254 targets; ~5191 rAF calls per scroll pass; 5 cursor-followers + 9 mousemove listeners; 4 video, 1 canvas, 49 draggable nodes; 0 @keyframes / 0 CSS animation rules (transforms driven in JS via dense IO threshold array + a 0.25/rootMargin:200px reveal observer); captured easing is bare 'ease', no explicit durations exposed. prefers-reduced-motion NOT respected (prmRules:0, a11y.reduced_motion:false) — the chief production liability. Hover: 'Book a demo' #fae261->black, 'Learn more' grey->black.

notes: Trust-the-screenshot corrections. (1) The raw profile's single most frequent color rgb(0,0,238) (count 147, identical in color+borderColor) is the unstyled UA-default link/border blue — a capture artifact; NO blue appears anywhere in the screenshots, so it is dropped, not treated as accent. (2) fontFamily count 1440 'sans-serif' is the unresolved generic fallback (web-font load race), not a real face; the actual faces are the registered ones: 'ABC Solar Display' for the big rounded headings, 'Haffer' for body, 'Haffer Mono' for eyebrow labels/badges/sticker words. ABC Solar reads as a soft humanist display (slightly serif-flared), so a Georgia-class fallback is listed before sans. (3) True background is the warm off-white rgb(240,242,239)=#f0f2ef (also the most common backgroundColor, count 41); cards are pure white. Foreground ink is rgb(42,15,20)=#2a0f14 — a near-black warm plum, NOT pure #000 — confirmed by the warm tint on headings. (4) Body grey rgb(118,110,112)=#766e70; a darker warm grey rgb(84,65,69)=#544145 is used for secondary/strong text. (5) Yellow rgb(250,226,97)=#fae261 is the one functional accent (primary pill CTA + highlighter underline behind 'irresistible'); coral/pink/plum/mint appear ONLY as highlighter blocks behind the mono words integrate/build/execute and as confetti — kept as 'sticker' roles, not core palette. (6) Radius normalized: pills are full (raw 132/500/816px = pill on varying widths); cards ~18-20px; small chips ~6px. Sub-pixel raws (7.35px, 4.59px, 23.69px etc.) are layout-computed fractions, rounded to the 4px-ish intent. (7) Weights are only 400/500 in the profile — a deliberately near-single-weight system; hierarchy is scale-driven. (8) px scale converted to rem at 16px root; display sizes 50/56/65px kept as the headline ramp.
